officialSources.observation: Ramallah municipality GIS portal links to its public city map and land-basin maps.

Ramallah municipal parcel Polygon layer. Safe native fields include MAIN_PARCEL_NO, PARCEL_NO, PARCEL_AREA_RE, BLOCK_NO_STRING, QUARTER_NO_STRING, CITY, BLOCKNONAME, QUARTERNONAME, PARCELHISTORICAL, LANDAREA, ACTIVE_INACTIVE, PARCELSOURCE and X/Y; owner-related tables and personal/editor fields were excluded.
Ramallah Municipality Arabic GIS-services page was opened; it describes the city spatial database, including plots, neighborhoods, basins and streets, and links to the municipal map.

Official ArcGIS item search listing in Arabic identifies a public Ramallah municipal map developed and managed by the municipal GIS unit, including parcel information; it is informational rather than legal proof.

requests.method: GET ArcGIS REST bounded query via requests
requests.outcome: application/geo+json returned 2 non-empty Polygon features in city bounding area. Only OBJECTID was requested; saved sample retains geometry only.
Opened and inspected the Arabic municipal GIS-services page; it describes municipal spatial data including plots and links the city map. No new parcel query in this follow-up.

registryBasis: The exact municipal parcel layer returned two Polygon features for a bounded area around Ramallah in a public query. This verifies partial city geometry only, not complete parcel coverage or land-title scope.

sourceCandidate.scope: City-area bounded request only; no completeness claim.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official municipal/national cadastral layer as published by its owner.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: 2 Polygon features from a bounded city-area request.

remainingUncertainty: Sample does not establish full city coverage, currency, legal title scope, or integration suitability.

projectedTopologyAudit.interpretation: The largest bounded-sample overlap persists in a fresh exact-ID reread in the source native CRS. Its area differs from EPSG:3857 due projection scale; the relative overlap fraction is stable.

largestOverlap.interpretation: Largest observed pair in the bounded EPSG:3857 audit was freshly reread from the provider in its native projected EPSG:28191 CRS. The overlap persists in native coordinates; the differing area reflects projection scale, not a topology change.

runtimeQualification.privacy: Query attributes limited to native object IDs; no owner/contact fields requested.

overlapCodeAudit.status: overlapping records were all ACTIVE_INACTIVE=Active and PARCELHISTORICAL=0; overlaps remain unexplained.

qualityDisposition.reason: 38 positive-area overlap pairs in the bounded 517-feature sample; the largest native-CRS overlap covers 47.76% of the smaller row. No repair or source-side exclusion was applied.

runtimeAssessment.reason: 38 sampled overlaps; the largest native-coordinate reread covers 47.76% of the smaller parcel. No repair or unsupported row exclusion applied.

pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city locator from reference data and manual seat placement; not an official boundary or WUP centroid.
